tracker_start_note: Report tracks NEW BUSINESS in existing stores. Two closure types only: (1) top-sku - rep landed one of the top-10 SKUs in a priority retail-category at a store that did not have it 1/1-5/31; (2) cat-new - store opened a retail-category line they were not selling 1/1-5/31. Cat-expansion (existing line, new non-top SKUs) is NOT a closure - those are reorders.
